name: dim_date
comment: Silver-layer calendar/date dimension. One row per calendar date, used to derive time-based fields during transformation.

columns.name: date_key
columns.comment: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD); the grain of this table and the join key used by every order_date_key/return_date_key column.

columns.name: cal_month
columns.comment: Calendar month number (1-12) of this date.

columns.name: year_month
columns.comment: Year and month as a sortable string (e.g. 2026-08), useful for month-over-month grouping.

columns.name: cal_quarter
columns.comment: Calendar quarter number (1-4) of this date.

columns.name: day_of_week
columns.comment: Day of week number for this date.

columns.name: is_weekend
columns.comment: TRUE when this date falls on a Saturday or Sunday.
